title: A temporal-aware machine learning framework enables microbial community dynamics prediction with personalized precision.
summary: MicroProphet, a time-aware Transformer with attention, forecasts subject-specific microbial abundance trajectories from incomplete longitudinal observations without data imputation. It uses only the first 30% of observed time points and was evaluated across synthetic communities, human gut microbiomes, infant gut development and corpse decomposition. The abstract reports cross-ecosystem predictive performance but gives no cohort sizes or numeric error measures; clinical or forensic decision outcomes were not tested.
